description: This is a Python script for generating and inserting CAMEO tags into OpenWrt firmware images, specifically targeting uImage headers and root filesystem partitions for use with D-Link DGS-1210 switches.

methods.name: read_buffer
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the uImage file at a given offset.

methods.name: write_buffer
methods.description: Writes a buffer to the uImage file at a specified position.

methods.name: cameosum
methods.description: Calculates a checksum by summing all bytes in a buffer and returning a 4-byte big-endian representation.

methods.name: invertcrc
methods.description: Calculates the CRC32 of a buffer, XORs with 0xffffffff, and returns a 4-byte little-endian checksum.

methods.name: checksum_header
methods.description: Modifies a uImage header buffer to include CAMEO tags and checksums, ensuring header integrity.
